text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the start of summer camp, where racers train to improve their skills. Fine Motion has been eagerly awaiting the day she can participate.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Wow, so this is the camp lodge! And I suppose this is the main hall? Are the bedchambers in another building?
choice_data_list: It's all in this one building.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that so?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I had this same question when I first saw the academy dorms, but Japanese people sure are adept at using space efficiently!

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text: Your Highness, the sweep of your room is complete. There are no issues. I'll take your luggage—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'll carry it myself, Captain. Please conduct yourself as usual.

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text: Understood. We're ready to provide assistance if needed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After she says this, the rest of the security detail line up in an inconspicuous location an appropriate distance from Fine Motion.
choice_data_list: I hope they don't get heatstroke…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It's fine! They're all professionals! They undergo training in the harshest of conditions.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Speaking of, our training starts today! I'm ready to go all out! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Huzzah!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Tch! Don't just stand there!

text_block_list.name: Chatting Umamusume
text_block_list.text: S-sorry… She's so scary!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: …Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Shakur's entrance ought to be preceded by a storm warning, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Shakur is a Double Crown champion, but she's been in a slump ever since she earned the title.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As someone who prizes data above all else, surely she understands the reason why, yet…
choice_data_list: There must be some kind of hurdle that she can't overcome.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: What a terribly difficult thing to go through.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It must be awfully lonely when you hurt everything you touch, just like the mighty spear Gae Bolg.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Shakur! Wait a moment!

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text: Your Highness! Please stop at once! It's dangerous!

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text: But Gae Bolg is a very dangerous weapon…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Shakur! Let's have a water fight!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: No. Shut up. Get lost. I'm sick of looking at you already.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, but such activities are a staple of youth. Now, I could do as you requested…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Or I could just splash you while you sit there defenseless!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: …?! Wait! At least let me put my computer away!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You may have five seconds. Five, four, three, two…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though her methods are high-handed, Fine Motion succeeds in getting Air Shakur to let off some steam.

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text: Her Highness is always doing things liable to give me a heart attack…

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text: Take the first time she met Air Shakur. Even though she'd read the background check we performed, she seemed to relish the chance to talk to her…

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text: Luckily, Air Shakur is far more rational than our results suggested, but…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I listen to the security captain grumble, but my thoughts turn to the summer camp ahead of us.
